en: Black‑and‑white view from a hillside lookout over a river bending through a European town. In the foreground three men in early 20th‑century clothing stand by a simple wooden railing, looking at the scenery. Across the river rises a large fortified complex with two tall, conical‑roofed towers and a long main building, resembling a medieval castle or fortress. Nearby are church buildings with steeples and clustered town houses, all surrounded by trees and gentle hills in the distance.
